newsitem.title: USA: Republic Automotive Parts buys distributor.
newsitem.headline: Republic Automotive Parts buys distributor.

text.p: Republic Automotive Parts Inc said on Tuesday its subsidiary Fenders & More Inc has acquired certain assets of Lewis Automotive Enterprises Ltd for cash, non-compete agreements and the assumption of certain liabilities.
Fenders & More is an automotive body parts subsidiary. Lewis Automotive Enterprises is doing business as Signal Bumper Exchange.
Signal Bumper Exchange, which is based in Ft. Ogelthorpe, Ga., is a privately held distributor of automotive body parts serving primarily Chattanooga, Tenn., and northern parts of Georgia.
